entities.name: Socrates
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Athenian philosopher (c. 470–399 BCE) who founded Western philosophical inquiry through his dialectic method of questioning. Executed for "corrupting the youth," he left no writings but profoundly influenced Plato and all subsequent Western thought.
